about: How a cutaway (B-roll, a web page) comes in over the host and goes out again. Each preset: label, kind (cut, fade, slide, pop, flash), dur in seconds (0.1 to 1.0), from (right, left, top, bottom: where a slide comes in from; it leaves the other way) and sound (a role of the sound kit: whoosh, pop, hit, ding, riser, or none). Add your own presets here; 'defaults' says which preset each kind of cutaway gets unless Settings or the clip says otherwise.

slide.label: Slide in from the right, with a whoosh

slide-up.label: Slide up from the bottom, with a whoosh

whip.label: Whip (a fast slide), with a whoosh

flash.label: Flash of white, with a whoosh
